name: oh2-r2s1-b512-s4a-16k-k4
note: W1 design v7 constants frozen by timing calibration (TC) under the frozen rule; no constant was chosen around the result. The tc block records the inputs; c_K, a_K and r are nearest-rank p99 values.

tc.basis: TC grid basis 2026-11-08: i7-13700K P-core threads 8-15 in one timing claim at normal priority (K = 4 workers pinned to CPUs 8, 10, 12 and 14; K = 1 to CPU 8), under the frozen load profile (human client session, relay, engine adapter and bridge, idle b512 bot and scorer, one page) in a 2-CPU claim on CPUs 22 and 23; kernel 4fccd3ebc bins, spellbench 27c9009bb; 128 positions from AC0-P's game set
tc.rule: design v7 sections 2 and 3: A_K = floor((T - m r) / (m c_K)), a_units = ceil(a_K / c_K), group_cap = 2 (B + a_units); (K, B) defined iff the per-tree median root simulations at B/K >= 8 and (B + a_units) E <= A_K; the largest defined B per K is selected
tc.other_candidates: 4k-k4 also defined (9 simulations per tree, 0.22 of A_4); 64k-k4 needs 2.26 x A_4
